messages:
sara_sales: Quick heads-up — Prospect 'Evernest' is asking for an on-prem private deployment pre-purchase. They want an integration preflight + timeline before legal. Key asks: air-gapped installer, HSM (Thales) support, perf SLAs, and a 3rd‑party CI hookup for automated deploys.
maya_pm: Ok — can someone run a quick feasibility triage? I want to capture non-negotiables and launch acceptance criteria so sales can quote.
ranjit_sre: I can start. Immediate blockers: outbound-only telemetry will be rejected by their security team. We'll need an offline telemetry bundle or an opt-out. Also confirm HW: are they planning multi-GPU or single-node? That affects autoscale expectations.
lucas_eng: From runtime side: air-gap + HSM is doable but requires packaging a static wheel + docs. Estimate ~2w infra work for air-gap packaging + 1w for HSM keywrap integration tests. Perf note: without prefix/KV cache sharing, p95 will increase — need perf targets from customer.
sean_security: Need details on HSM mode: do they require remote HSM vs client-hosted? Also require encryption-at-rest key rotation, attestation, and audit logs. We'll need their SOC2/ISO certs and a short questionnaire from them.
sara_sales: They said Thales Luna 7. Hosted HSM not allowed. Also they require data residency in EU and a monthly uptime SLA of 99.95.
maya_pm: Draft of acceptance criteria for this intake (proposed): 1) Successful install in customer lab w/ air-gapped packages, 2) HSM integration with key ops validated end-to-end, 3) Perf p95 <= 300ms for their 8k token median workload, 4) Security checklist passed (attestation + audit logs), 5) Billing & contract template for Dedicated pricing. Thoughts?
ranjit_sre: Add: recovery/patch process documented for air-gapped installs. Also offline upgrades procedure.
nora_support: We'll need runbook snippets and support SLAs in the contract. Suggest adding a telemetry health-check that they can run locally (small script) and a support contact handoff doc.
lucas_eng: For resource sizing: if they want 200 RPS at small responses, recommended baseline is 2x A100 or equivalent. I'll add a note: quantized model variants might help but could impact quality.
sean_security: Also require customer-provided firewall rules and an installation checklist that includes CA certs for mTLS. I'll prepare a short security questionnaire (5-7 items) to send them.
maya_pm: Good. Let's capture dependencies: (a) legal signoff for on-prem license, (b) HSM test keys from customer, (c) access to their lab network for the PoC window, (d) perf dataset from customer, (e) schedule for security review. Add to backlog?
prod-bot: Created issue INF-2467: "Evernest preflight — airgap + HSM + PoC checklist" and added label "enterprise-intake". Assigned to maya_pm.
sara_sales: Thanks. Customer wants an indicative timeline for the PoC (not full rollout). What can we commit to? They asked for a 6–8 week window.
lucas_eng: PoC timeline (rough): week 0: kick-off + deliverables; week 1–2: create airgap package + HSM wiring; week 3: installer run in lab; week 4: perf tuning and validation; week 5: security review & fixes; week 6: final sign-off. So 6 weeks seems tight but doable if they provide HSM test credentials and perf dataset on day 0.
ranjit_sre: We need a dedicated eng-sre owner for the PoC nights — I can volunteer 20% time. Also need an ops checklist for maintenance windows.
maya_pm: I'll turn this into a scoped PRD for the intake: include acceptance criteria above, dependency checklist, timeline, owner list, and a go/no-go decision gate after week 3 installer validation. I'll also add a prioritized backlog item (P1) for air-gapped installer and a P2 for automating HSM key rotation.
sara_sales: Can you also include an estimated cost delta for Dedicated vs Hosted so I can prep procurement? Rough numbers are fine.
lucas_eng: I'll draft sizing + cost-amortization notes and attach to the PRD.
maya_pm: Action items: 1) ranjit: draft ops checklist + offline telemetry options (due EOD Thu), 2) sean: send security questionnaire to customer (due EOD Wed), 3) lucas: rough PoC resource & cost (due Fri), 4) nora/support: prepare runbook template and SLAs (due Fri). I'll create the PRD and link the INF ticket.
sara_sales: Sounds good. I'll request HSM test keys and perf corpus from Evernest today and push for their lab availability.
maya_pm: Thanks team. If we hit blockers, escalate to eng-platform for kernel/quantization tradeoffs. Will update sales on estimates after PRD is posted. :thumbsup:
